svg.title: S5 - Alternative charging point for displaced requests (UC-M4-07), called from UC-M3-08

g.text: S5 - Alternative charging point for displaced requests (UC-M4-07), called from UC-M3-08
UC-M3-08: look for a free port in the same Hub
Reassign the session or re-queue (M3 only)
Ask for alternatives for the displaced requests
Free charging bays per Hub, as_of
Order requests (BR-M4-01, then BR-M3-03 inside the charging class)
Offer each free bay to at most one request
Rank other Hubs by closeness, free bays, Hub ID
Alternative Hub and bay per request
Move or re-queue sessions (M3 owns the failure handling)
Read-only: no resource is held by M4.
M3 confirms the new bay through its own flow.
